name: Extinguishant hold off/abort button, single gang
family: Fire Extinguishant Call Points, Abort & Hold Buttons
summary: A surface or flush mounting hold or abort button designed to connect to an EP203/CON automatic extinguisher panel to provide a means of delaying or cancelling the extinguishant release sequence.

specs.label: Alarm current
specs.value: Determined by the type of control equipment and number / type of field devices connected to the system.

specs.label: Product dimensions (mm)
specs.value: 87 H x 87 W x 58 D mm. Surface or flush mounting.

specs.label: Construction & finish
specs.value: Polycarbonate. Green push button, yellow call point housing, black back box.

features: Comprises a 35mm black back box, yellow lid and green push button.
Supplied with two branding label options (‘Extinguishant Hold Off’ and ‘Extinguishant Abort’).
Actual operation depends on wiring configuration (if hold and abort functions are required, at least two EP215 buttons will be needed).
